preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the graph is between 1 and 10000, inclusive.
The number of edges in the graph is between 0 and 200000, inclusive.
The vertices u and v are within the range [0, V-1].
The weight of each edge is between 1 and 99, inclusive.
The source vertex s and the destination vertex t are within the range [0, V-1].

postconditions.description: The output is the number of different shortest paths between the source vertex s and the destination vertex t.
